integrity: All square minors are recomputed exactly in the cyclotomic integer ring Z[zeta_30] using a standalone integer-arithmetic verifier; no floating-point determinant test is used.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to the unique index-\(4\) subgroup of \(\mathbb F_{25}^{\times}\).
It does not characterize index-four compressed Fourier matrices over arbitrary finite fields.
Unindexed or differently phrased equivalent literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Index-four compressed Fourier minors over \(\mathbb F_{25}\)
